data.best_today: Your gut call: Raise price 8% now

data.headline: Order one extra week of stock now, then raise price 3% in week 4
data.why: The extra week of inventory costs about $11k but avoids a $25k profit hit if GPU prices jump 25% as assumed. A small price increase in week 4 recovers margin while the rival stays at $415. Peak cash need stays under the $40k you have.
data.watch_out: If the GPU cost surge does not materialize, you carry an extra week of stock that cost $11k and the 3% price rise may slow sales more than expected.
data.recheck_when: Review when supplier quotes arrive or by week 3, whichever comes first.
